format: AEBNDR01: u32base_width,u32base_height;4f64 west,north,coarse_step_lon,coarse_step_lat;u32vertex_count,u32face_count;vertex_count local[row,column]f64pairs;face_count[3u32indices,u8class]. No height or ECEF coordinate is stored.

surface.model: Exact WGS84 ellipsoid for all physical queries
surface.presentation: All parameters projected directly to WGS84 h=0; finite triangle chords are display approximations only

reconstruction.added_vertex_record_format: Implicit global index original_width*original_height+list_position; [0,native_row,native_column] source post, [1,midpoint_row,midpoint_column] source-edge crossing, [2,a,b,c] source-parameter barycenter, [3,row,column,curve_index,t] cubic sample
reconstruction.contour: Binary native quad outer-edge midpoints, fixed NW-SE halves only for ambiguous checkerboards; G1 cubic rounding contained in each convex source parent, chord-monotone controls and bounded de Casteljau subdivision. All geographic parameters are projected to WGS84 h=0 for presentation; no heights are read. Inland category mixtures remain unresolved.

limitations: Regional categorical coverage only; no inferred global land or ocean.
Smooth reconstructed borders do not add surveyed source resolution.
No DEM, geoid displacement, terrain relief, tides, wave geometry or bathymetry.
